floor_history.headline: Recon baseline 18 (91 vs 91 insns, pure RA+sched). Cluster-A callee-save rotation mechanism CONFIRMED via cc1 -da: the goto-loop emits no NOTE_INSN_LOOP_BEG, so allocno_compare ranks the param above t

Cluster A SOLVED — a real loop plus ONE reused scratch local holding both loop-invariant compare constants defeats loop.c's hoisting and lands target's exact $s0-$s3 map with only four callee-saves; f

frontier.hypothesis: The +2 tail residual is a block-ORDER decision, not an exit-spelling one: GCC lays the 'ret = 1; while (a0 == 0)' tail block after the exit jump, so the mask branch comes out inverted with an extra 'j end', where target falls straight through from 'beqz $v0,.L80081CFC' into 'beqz $s2,.L80081C10'.
frontier.mechanism: jump.c / final block ordering after the loop is expanded. The register allocation is already correct and unaffected, so this is the only remaining structural axis for the larger half of the residual. Return-vs-break spelling has been measured dead (both 19/93).
frontier.next_probe: Invert the mask test's source sense so the loop-continue side is the fall-through (if (*D_800A14C0 & k) { ret = 1; } else { ret = 0; break; }); fold the mask test and the a0 back-edge condition into one loop condition; and try 'continue' for the loop-continue path. Screen each with tmp/grind/saEft01Init/s2/score.py — the sweep.py .lreg predictor does not see block layout, so these need real sandbox runs.

frontier.hypothesis: The -1 / mis-scheduled 0x3C0000 materialisation is fixable by moving the reused holder k out of $a0 into $v0 without folding it into the v0 flag local (which regresses to 22/93).
frontier.mechanism: k has nrefs=8, live_length=6 and lands in $a0, which is free early enough for the scheduler to hoist 'lui a0,0x3c' into the bnez delay slot at build idx 31. Target's holder is $v0, freed only by the immediately preceding slt, so the lui cannot move up past it.
frontier.next_probe: Read .lreg for k under variants that lengthen its live range slightly or split the reuse across two locals that each still get two sets; move 'k = 0x3C0000;' to sit between the 'D_800F19BC = cnt + 1;' store and the compare; verify with sweep.py that the $s0-$s3 map is unchanged and with grind_diff.py that the nop at build idx 31 is restored.

frontier.hypothesis: Cluster B (the debug_printf argument block, regfix.txt:105-113) can now be re-diffed for the first time on a CORRECT cluster-A allocation, and part of the $2<->$3 / $2<->$4 rename cluster will have vanished on its own.
frontier.mechanism: Session 1 could not separate cluster B from cluster A because the arg-block address chains indexed off $s1 in our build and $s0 in target. As of the session-2 candidate both index off $s0, so any residual in that block is now genuinely independent.
frontier.next_probe: Re-run tmp/grind/saEft01Init/s1/grind_diff.py on the candidate and re-score both arg-staging orders (arg4-first and arg5-first) with score.py against the corrected allocation — session 1 measured them tied at 18 under the WRONG allocation, so that tie must be re-measured before any further arg-block work.
